<function name="IsCoplanar" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this Nav Area is in the same plane as the given one.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="navArea" type="CNavArea">The Nav Area to test.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether we're coplanar or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
